nodes.label: Vite + TypeScript + React + shadcn-ui + Tailwind Stack
dist/ Production Build
nodes.rationale: npm run build emits dist/; the entire contents must sit at the document root so index.html is served directly.

nodes.label: CloudPanel Nginx SPA Vhost Config
nodes.rationale: CloudPanel runs Nginx, which never reads .htaccess, so the try_files directive in the vhost is the only working SPA fallback there.

nodes.label: Apache .htaccess SPA Fallback
nodes.rationale: public/.htaccess is copied into dist/ automatically; requires mod_rewrite enabled on cPanel/shared hosting.

nodes.label: SPA 404-on-Refresh Problem
nodes.rationale: React Router routes such as /checkout exist only in the browser; a refresh or shared deep link asks the server for a path with no file on disk, so the server returns its own 404 and the app never boots.

nodes.label: try_files index.html Fallback Rule
nodes.rationale: Any request that is not a real file must return index.html with HTTP 200; only the per-server syntax differs.

nodes.label: Server/Panel Fallback Matrix
nodes.rationale: Panels split by whether they read .htaccess: CloudPanel and plain Nginx need a vhost edit, LiteSpeed/Apache ship .htaccess in dist/, Netlify uses _redirects and Vercel uses vercel.json.

nodes.label: PHP readfile() SPA Workaround
nodes.rationale: For a PHP site in CloudPanel, Nginx already routes unknown paths to index.php, so a one-line index.php readfile serves the SPA without vhost access. Explicitly a workaround, not a fix: it adds a PHP round trip to every page load; prefer try_files.

nodes.label: Cache-Control no-cache on index.html
nodes.rationale: index.html references content-hashed asset filenames; a cached copy points at files the new deploy deleted and the site renders a blank white page, so both shipped configs set Cache-Control: no-cache.

nodes.label: Deep-Link 200 Verification Checks
nodes.rationale: curl -I on /, /checkout, /product/123 and /size-chart must all return 200; a 404 proves the server config never took effect.

nodes.label: Razorpay + Supabase Setup Guide
nodes.rationale: Documents taking Razorpay from no configured secrets to a live, retry-safe checkout, including the first-attempt-fails/retry-succeeds case.

nodes.label: Supabase Project Ref qksewiceckymrsvgxkfg
nodes.rationale: Ref was taken from VITE_SUPABASE_URL because supabase/config.toml previously named a different, empty project, so CLI deploys from this repo were landing nowhere.

nodes.label: Deployment State Probe (2026-08-12)
nodes.rationale: Probe found razorpay-webhook rejecting unauthenticated POSTs with 401 UNAUTHORIZED_NO_AUTH_HEADER, razorpay-reconcile and woocommerce-taxes undeployed (404), and VITE_RAZORPAY_KEY_ID missing from .env.

nodes.label: verify-razorpay-payment Edge Function
nodes.rationale: Authenticates its own caller via the Razorpay payment signature HMAC rather than a Supabase JWT.

nodes.label: razorpay-webhook Edge Function
nodes.rationale: Acts as the safety net that settles an order even when the browser never returns; authenticates callers with the x-razorpay-signature HMAC.

nodes.label: razorpay-reconcile Edge Function
nodes.rationale: Final backstop: GET /v1/orders/{id}/payments returns every attempt Razorpay recorded (failures included), so it can repair any order whose status disagrees with the money. Authenticates with a Bearer service role key compared in constant time, so it must never be called from the browser.

nodes.label: woocommerce-taxes Edge Function
nodes.rationale: Not deployed (404), which is why GST does not show at checkout.

nodes.label: Three Idempotent Settlement Paths
nodes.rationale: Browser verification, webhook and reconcile can each settle an order; all three are idempotent so it does not matter which one wins.

nodes.label: payment_initiation_logs Table
nodes.rationale: Records order creation at the gateway with receipt = order_<wooId>, which is how a debited-but-orderless payment is traced back.

nodes.label: payment_attempts Table
nodes.rationale: One row per attempt, with a unique constraint on (provider, gateway_payment_id) and upsert-only writes so Razorpay duplicate deliveries and the authorized to captured progression collapse into one row.

nodes.label: payment_attempt_summary View
nodes.rationale: Collapses attempts to one row per gateway order so paid-after-failure orders are visible.

nodes.label: Supabase Edge Function Secrets
nodes.rationale: SUPABASE_URL and SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY are injected by the platform and must not be added manually (Supabase rejects SUPABASE_-prefixed secrets). Secrets only apply to functions deployed after they are set, so changing one requires a redeploy.

nodes.label: RAZORPAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET
nodes.rationale: Self-generated (openssl rand -hex 32) and must match the Razorpay dashboard exactly; a mismatch is the number one cause of 'webhook fires but nothing happens'.

nodes.label: VITE_RAZORPAY_KEY_ID Browser Key
nodes.rationale: Only the public Key ID may be exposed in a VITE_ variable; the Key Secret in a VITE_ variable must be rotated immediately. VITE_ values are baked into the bundle at build time, so a new value needs a new build.

nodes.label: verify_jwt = false in config.toml
nodes.rationale: Mandatory for razorpay-webhook: Razorpay cannot send a Supabase token, so with JWT verification on every webhook is rejected with 401 before the function code runs. Each function authenticates its own callers instead.

nodes.label: Razorpay Webhook Event Subscription
nodes.rationale: payment.captured, payment.authorized, payment.failed and order.paid are all required; payment.failed specifically underpins the retry story by recording the failed first attempt. Razorpay retries failed deliveries up to 5 times with backoff, and webhook config does not carry over from Test to Live Mode.

nodes.label: Failure-then-Retry Order Recovery
nodes.rationale: The original flow silently lost paid orders: the browser PUT the order to failed on the first decline, and the webhook only promoted orders in pending/on-hold, so a successful retry was skipped. Now the browser writes failed/cancelled only in ondismiss (guarded by paymentSucceeded), and both webhook and verify promote from pending, on-hold, failed or cancelled to processing while never touching processing, completed or refunded; recovered orders carry _payment_recovered_from meta for auditing.

nodes.label: Stock Restock/Reduce on Recovery
nodes.rationale: Cancelling restores WooCommerce stock and moving back to processing reduces it again, so recovery from cancelled logs a 'verify stock levels' warning for tight inventory.

nodes.label: WooCommerce Order Integration
nodes.rationale: All order state writes go through the WooCommerce REST API with consumer key/secret; orders carry _razorpay_payment_id and _payment_verified_via meta.

nodes.label: Hourly pg_cron Reconcile Sweep
nodes.rationale: Uses pg_cron + pg_net to POST a sweep; the service role key is stored in Vault rather than inlined in the job definition.

nodes.label: RLS With No Policies on Payment Tables
nodes.rationale: Both payment tables enable RLS with zero policies, making them invisible to the anon key and readable only via the service role (SQL editor, edge functions).

nodes.label: Live Mode Go-Live Checklist
nodes.rationale: Test and live keys are separate and webhook config does not carry over, so every step must be repeated in Live Mode and all four functions redeployed.

nodes.label: Happy Path / Retry / Dropped-Browser Tests
nodes.rationale: Uses Razorpay test card 4111 1111 1111 1111 and test VPAs failure@razorpay / success@razorpay; killing the tab before the success toast proves the webhook settles the order (_payment_verified_via = webhook).
